liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Gimme Some Lovin'** (2 reviews): Phil poured on bass; Brent laid out early, then played Hammond B3 after the second verse, pleasing the crowd; Reviewer calls Gimme Some Lovin' and Morning Dew standout renditions [24][28]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the Shakedown Street as great [25]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Phil shook the Greek during the Dew; Jerry added effects after the quiet intro, during the closing jam [24]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): Reviewer says the Lovelight rocks, and Bertha does too [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-07-15.143091.preFM.beta.miller.flac2496** (recommended): pre-FM broadcast master; 21 songs; 235 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1988-07-15.140749.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1644**: audience recording; 22 songs; 164 min [3]
- **gd88-07-15.sbd.clugston.10343.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 158 min; rated 3.55/5 by 11 [8]. Said about its sound: Says the Clugston matrix has better highs, bass, vocals and drums than the other version, though both lack something [22]
- **gd1988-07-15.sbd.braverman.10079.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 158 min; rated 1.33/5 by 3 [9]. Said about its sound: A few seconds of music are missing around 3:04, possibly from tape flips [9]
- **gd1988-07-15.sbd.clugston.braverman.tetzeli.fix-10343.34751.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 158 min [10]
- **gd88-07-15.schoeps-weber-small.gardner.9244.sbefail.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 175 min; rated 4.29/5 by 17 [17]. Said about its sound: Calls the Schoeps audience recording one of the best audience tapes the reviewer has heard, preferable to the soundboard matrix; A brief stretch around 1:09-1:13 in Morning Dew sounds mono, possibly a dropout in one channel, unmentioned in notes [21][28]
- **gd1988-07-15.160873.akgck61-beyerm201.hollbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 20 songs; 157 min [18]. Said about its sound: Tape has a quick flip cut about two minutes from the end of a tune [18]

## Around the show

- Opening Shakedown follows about 84 seconds of tuning; reviewer finds it loud and funky, true to form [27]
- The concert was a Rex benefit, broadcast live on KPFA Berkeley [3]
- Reviewer considers this show exceptional for 1988 [30]
- Jerry's Dew effort is very strong, but the show isn't top five of 1988; reviewer prefers 9/18 [32]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-07-15.143091.preFM.beta.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Pre-FM (KPFA Air-Check) > Beta HiFi Master (Sony ES-HG) [1]
- **gd1988-07-15.140749.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Charlie Miller and Scott Clugston; source: Ted Mattes' Master Audience PCM (Nakamichi DMP-100 deck, Sony ESX-HiFi/L750 tape); Schoeps CMC3/MK41 mics, ortf (OTS); Transfer Info: Master PCM (Sony SL-10)>… [3]
- **gd88-07-15.sbd.clugston.10343.sbeok.shnf**: source: Ultramatrix (SBD/AUD mix)> DAT> ?> CD ("?" may not be a generation, or it may be. I dunno.) [8]
- **gd1988-07-15.sbd.braverman.10079.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Peter Braverman; source: Ultramatrix > DAT [9]
- **gd1988-07-15.sbd.clugston.braverman.tetzeli.fix-10343.34751.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Fix of shnid 10343 [10]. Also: Gap in Good Time Blues and Estimated patched with the same audience source Clugston used, using crossfades; CD 2/3 transition made seamless [10]
- **gd88-07-15.schoeps-weber-small.gardner.9244.sbefail.shnf**: source: 2nd Row Behind Healy (see notes): Schoeps CMC42S (Spaced Omni 14' Split --> Oade Power Supply --> Sony PCM-F1 with Apogee modified A/D filters [17]
- **gd1988-07-15.160873.akgck61-beyerm201.hollbrook.flac2448**: taped by Billy Myrick, Tom Pinney, Phil Schuman, Kyle Holbrook, John Goode; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: microphones: Beyer M201's aimedFWD (0')about 2 feet wide mixed with AKG ck61's XY> Tascam 442# mixed to 2 channels on the fly > recorder: Sony TCD5M|Maxell MX… [18]. Also: First generation from the dbx 4-channel master, decoded with a dbx224 [18]
